content.short: Sherpa token ($SPA) is a tribute to the brave heroes from the Himalayas.
content.description:
Our team consists of members from the Sherpa Community who are now living in different parts of the world. But we've seen the struggle and hardship that the Sherpas still face today in the Himalayas. Our major interest is to work on uplifting the livelihood of the Sherpa Community through this community driven token.

Phase one has an objective of circulating the $SPA to the global market that will create a group of activists who will support the Sherpas of the mountains. Listing on Sundaeswap and major DEXes will increase the distribution and engagement of token for a global exposure.

Phase two will focus on implementing the utility ot $SPA by creating an ecosystem to exchange $SPA for goods and services among the Sherpa community and the rest of the world. Agreements will be signed with government entities and international mountaineering communities to springboot this milestone.

During the phase three, the transactions profit accumulated will incentivize the users to increase the utility of the token and a fixed percentage of the profit will be deposited in the "Sherpa Token Trust." The amount raised from the trust will be used to better the livelihoods of the people from the mountains in the Sherpa community.
